== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silverlords are an elite and highly individualistic organization of powerful beings, often identified by the silver crowns they wear. They function as conquerors who gather armies from the worlds they subdue, frequently stripping [[Iterations]] of their resources and personnel. Even by the high standards of [[Judges]], they are considered formidable elites; their combined [[willpower]] is capable of eroding powerful barriers, and they often work in coordination with other forces like the [[Vroshir]]. In combat, Silverlords are known for their diverse and unique abilities, ranging from the control of star-sized diamond [[chains]] to the summoning of black-feathered birds. They are highly tactical, utilizing specialized equipment and artifacts to hide themselves from [[Abidan]] detection. While they can act as a cohesive unit—such as when chanting in tandem to harness the energy of plundered worlds—they are also characterized by their independence. They have been known to hold entire worlds for ransom or act as expendable guards while larger forces remain in reserve. A common saying among [[Judges]] suggests that their numbers are vast, noting that there are always more Silverlords.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silverlords have taken control of [[Threshold]] to hold the realm for ransom. A single Silverlord, appearing as a raven crowned in a silver halo, currently holds the location while at least a dozen more remain in reserve. Although this individual was struck by black fire and is viewed as expendable by her peers, fifteen Silverlords have concentrated their presence near [[Lindon]]. As the [[Reaper]] considers bargaining for the release of [[Threshold]], [[Jek’nan]] begins to feel more like a Silverlord than an [[Abidan]].}}
